accepted_risks.reason: The coordinator and reviewer run without the CEL tool allowlist (orch_tool_allowlist), like Omnigent's default agents. What remains: linux_bwrap ($HOME unmounted except ~/.claude, ~/.claude.json and ~/.nvm; dot-paths in the workspace masked except .git, .nvm, .claude; writes only to runs/ subdirectories), permission_mode default, the pre-approved calls of agent-prompt-preapproval, tool cap and loop guard. Lost: the OS-independent denial of network commands (the agents' network is open, including the unauthenticated Omnigent API at 127.0.0.1:6767, which can approve pending prompts) and of reads under runs/ (Codex session histories may carry prompt injection) and of ~/.claude credentials; each now rests on the user declining that call in Claude's prompt. The approval of a runs/requests write is Claude's prompt, so a session switched to acceptEdits or bypass in the UI, or an 'always allow' for broad Bash, removes it. The reviewer can also write runs/proposals without a prompt (its sandbox writes all of runs/).

accepted_risks.reason: FE tasks with runner "claude" are implemented by Claude Code (claude -p --chrome) instead of Codex. Claude in Chrome drives the user's everyday Chrome, so the implementer can open any site the user is signed in to (GitHub, mail, banking) and read or act there; the prompt limits it to localhost pages, nothing enforces that. Its shell commands run in Claude Code's bwrap sandbox (writes only in the worktree and the run's temp dir; reads of ~/.ssh, ~/.codex, ~/.omnigent, gh/docker/npm credentials, BE-P/FE-P .env and ORCH-P/runs denied; network only to localhost); its file tools are limited to the worktree; git commit/push/merge/reset/checkout/config, gh, curl, wget, package installs, WebFetch/WebSearch and sub-agents are denied. ORCH-P's scope check, Git metadata check, containerized gate, commit binding and review still apply. The FE reviewer stays Claude (another session), so review is no longer by a different model; ORCH_IMPLEMENTER stops the implementer recording a review.
accepted_risks.scope: FE side, runner claude only; BE stays Codex with the Step 0 profile
